title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — Ending Health-Care Absence Monitoring on the Borrower's Return
content:
Health-care absence monitoring on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile ends with the primary borrower's return home on an accepted return-home notice. This entry governs the response days the open certification cycle is given when that return is recorded; the status change and the clearing of the absence start date remain exactly as the product's rules on health-care absences provide.

## Scope

When monitoring ends with the borrower's return, the profile becomes current and the absence start date is cleared, and any cycle whose due date passed during the absence is re-dated under this rule, while a cycle whose due date did not pass during the absence keeps the due date the profile shows.

## Condition on the profile

> The return is not recorded until the borrower's own confirmation that the borrower is back home stands on the profile as a check-in.

In the same terms: while no check-in on the profile carries the borrower's own confirmation of being back home, the return is not recorded.

## What recording the return does

On the strength of the accepted return-home notice cited, the servicing agent records that occupancy has resumed: the profile's status becomes current, its absence start date is cleared, and the due date of the open certification cycle becomes the date that lies the given number of calendar days after today. Nothing else on the profile changes.

## Invocation

`record_return_home_baa2f4ef` is an agent-side tool, unlocked by the servicing agent and then called.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `residency_profile_id` | reference number of the occupancy certification profile under monitoring, as returned by the occupancy profile lookup for the borrower | identifier |
| `residency_submission_id` | reference number of the most recently received accepted return-home notice on file for the profile, as returned by the occupancy submission lookup | identifier |
| `response_days` | the calendar days from today to the due date the open certification cycle is to carry once occupancy has resumed | integer written without decimals; negative when that due date lies before today |

## Receipt

One line of the form "Profile <profile reference> back to current on return notice <notice reference>; open cycle due <new due date YYYY-MM-DD>." Its presence, rather than a line beginning "Error", means the profile is current, its absence start date is empty and it carries that due date.
